# wallix.bastion.domain

Manage global domains on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.0.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create, update or delete a global domain on a WALLIX Bastion.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_domain` Terraform resource.
- Accounts of the domain and their credentials are managed with [`wallix.bastion.domain_account`](domain_account.md) and [`wallix.bastion.domain_account_credential`](domain_account_credential.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter-admin-account"></a>**admin_account** | `str` | Name of the account of this domain used to change passwords.<br>The account must already exist (see [`wallix.bastion.domain_account`](domain_account.md)), so it cannot be set when the domain is created. Set it in a later task.<br>Only kept by the Bastion while [`enable_password_change=true`](#parameter-enable-password-change). |
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-ca-private-key"></a>**ca_private_key** | `str` | Private key of the SSH certificate authority of the domain, or `generate:<TYPE>` to let the Bastion generate one, for example `generate:RSA_4096` or `generate:ED25519`.<br>The Bastion never returns it, so it cannot be compared. It is sent when the domain is created, when the domain has no CA key yet, and on every run with [`update_password=always`](#parameter-update-password), except that a `generate:` value is never sent to a domain that already has a key.<br>Mutually exclusive with [`vault_plugin`](#parameter-vault-plugin). |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-description"></a>**description** | `str` | Description of the domain. |
| <a id="parameter-domain-name"></a>**domain_name** | `str` / required | Name of the domain. Identifies the domain on the Bastion. |
| <a id="parameter-domain-real-name"></a>**domain_real_name** | `str` | Real name of the domain, as used to connect to targets (for example `corp.example.com`). |
| <a id="parameter-enable-password-change"></a>**enable_password_change** | `bool` | Whether the Bastion changes the passwords of the accounts of this domain.<br>`true` needs [`password_change_policy`](#parameter-password-change-policy) and [`password_change_plugin`](#parameter-password-change-plugin), on the Bastion or in the task.<br>`false` makes the Bastion clear [`admin_account`](#parameter-admin-account), [`password_change_policy`](#parameter-password-change-policy), [`password_change_plugin`](#parameter-password-change-plugin) and [`password_change_plugin_parameters`](#parameter-password-change-plugin-parameters). |
| <a id="parameter-passphrase"></a>**passphrase** | `str` | Passphrase protecting [`ca_private_key`](#parameter-ca-private-key). Sent along with [`ca_private_key`](#parameter-ca-private-key). |
| <a id="parameter-password-change-plugin"></a>**password_change_plugin** | `str` | Name of the password change plugin, for example `Unix`. |
| <a id="parameter-password-change-plugin-parameters"></a>**password_change_plugin_parameters** | `dict` | Parameters of the password change plugin, as a dictionary (a JSON string is accepted).<br>Treated as a secret. Sent when the domain is created, when the Bastion has no parameters yet, and on every run with [`update_password=always`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-password-change-policy"></a>**password_change_policy** | `str` | Name of the password change policy, for example `default`. |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Whether the domain should exist.<br>Deleting a domain deletes its accounts and their credentials.<br><br>Choices: `present` (default), `absent` |
| <a id="parameter-update-password"></a>**update_password** | `str` | `on_create` sends the secret options ([`ca_private_key`](#parameter-ca-private-key), [`passphrase`](#parameter-passphrase), [`password_change_plugin_parameters`](#parameter-password-change-plugin-parameters), [`vault_plugin_parameters`](#parameter-vault-plugin-parameters)) only when the domain is created or when the Bastion has no value for them yet.<br>`always` sends them on every run, which then always reports a change.<br><br>Choices: `always`, `on_create` (default) |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-vault-plugin"></a>**vault_plugin** | `str` | Name of the external vault plugin managing the accounts of the domain.<br>Can only be set when the domain is created; changing it fails. Delete and recreate the domain instead.<br>Mutually exclusive with [`enable_password_change=true`](#parameter-enable-password-change) and [`ca_private_key`](#parameter-ca-private-key). |
| <a id="parameter-vault-plugin-parameters"></a>**vault_plugin_parameters** | `dict` | Parameters of [`vault_plugin`](#parameter-vault-plugin), as a dictionary (a JSON string is accepted).<br>Treated as a secret, like [`password_change_plugin_parameters`](#parameter-password-change-plugin-parameters). |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- Options left unset keep their current value on the Bastion.
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Declare an Active Directory domain
  wallix.bastion.domain:
    domain_name: corp
    domain_real_name: corp.example.com
    description: Corporate domain

- name: Give the domain an SSH certificate authority generated by the Bastion
  wallix.bastion.domain:
    domain_name: corp
    ca_private_key: generate:RSA_4096

- name: Create the account used to change passwords
  wallix.bastion.domain_account:
    domain_name: corp
    account_name: svc-pwchange
    account_login: svc-pwchange

- name: Enable password change with that account
  wallix.bastion.domain:
    domain_name: corp
    admin_account: svc-pwchange
    enable_password_change: true
    password_change_policy: default
    password_change_plugin: Unix
    password_change_plugin_parameters:
      host: 192.0.2.1

- name: Remove a domain and all its accounts
  wallix.bastion.domain:
    domain_name: corp
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Options that differed from the Bastion and were updated.<br>Contains the secret options sent because of [`update_password=always`](#parameter-update-password) or because the Bastion had no value for them.<br><br>Returned: when the domain already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `["description"]` |
| <a id="return-domain"></a>**domain** | `dict` | The domain as returned by the Bastion API after the change, without the secret options.<br>In check mode, the expected domain. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-domain) |
